name: Rizuhble's Dyson Dynamo
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, for Unstoppable.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-10,400 (levels 1-17). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Kinetic Pulse T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Recharging Rush, vitality 4.8k at Warp Stone. Ultimate (Singularity) is available from Sprint Boots.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Recharging Rush completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Recharging Rush completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Kinetic Pulse (133) clears its 80-damage trigger.

items.name: Headhunter
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Recharging Rush completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Headshot Booster (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Recharging Rush completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Warp Stone, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Warp Stone, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Warp Stone
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Teleport into the middle of them, then ult.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 10,400-20,800 (levels 17-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Singularity T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Kinetic Pulse, damage) grows from 288 to 406. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Kinetic Pulse (312) clears its 165-damage trigger. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Kinetic Pulse: takes 18% off its 26s base cooldown.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Kinetic Pulse: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Kinetic Pulse (2 to 3).

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Kinetic Pulse (3 to 4). Takes spirit from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 9,600 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 318s; 20% off is 63.6s per full rotation.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,800-51,200 (levels 26-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Quantum Entanglement T3, Rejuvenating Aurora T3.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Kinetic Pulse: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Quicksilver Reload (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Quantum Entanglement (movement) and Rejuvenating Aurora (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Pop it before you ult so they can't stun you out of it.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 22,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 318s of base cooldown across your kit, 250s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Warp Stone? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Rapid Recharge.
sections.desc: Dying after Warp Stone? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Rapid Recharge.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown before it lands, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They stun you as you walk in.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 46.5 to Kinetic Pulse's damage (1.55x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Replaces Rapid Recharge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Kinetic Pulse: resets its 26s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Replaces Rapid Recharge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Kinetic Pulse. Sell Rapid Recharge for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
